subject: The gsoc-r blog was added to R-bloggers

messages.author: b24c10731fdfceaf
messages.subject: The gsoc-r blog was added to R-bloggers
parts:
Hello everyone, 
Congratulations to your success in this year's gsoc R projects.


After consulting with Dirk Eddelbuettel on the topic, I have added this year's gsoc R blog:
http://gsoc2010r.wordpress.com/
To R-bloggers:
http://www.r-bloggers.com/

This means that your online content from this summer will get (a bit) more exposure.  And that if any of you will have a follow-up to your project that you would like to post on the blog, then the content will now be visible to (approximately) 2,500 readers from the R community.

If any of you feels that you would rather have your content withdrawn (either from the blog, or from R-bloggers), for what ever reason, simply e-mail me and I'll remove it.

I wish you all many more successful projects,
Best,
Tal
